notablePrerequisites: You have not copied a spell using Chandra this turn.
description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Emerald Charm without paying its mana cost, targeting Isochron Scepter.
Chandra and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Chandra.
Resolve the Chandra trigger, creating a copy of Emerald Charm, targeting Lotus Field.
Resolve both Emerald Charms, untapping Isochron Scepter and Lotus Field.
Repeat.
